t: Venezuela left Gran Colombia in 1830 under José Antonio Páez and for a century was ruled mainly by caudillos.
Oil found in the 1910s and 1920s made it a leading exporter, a founder of OPEC and a stable democracy after 1958.
Under Hugo Chávez and Nicolás Maduro it became the Bolivarian Republic, then suffered economic collapse and mass emigration.
dyk: Venezuela has the world’s largest proven oil reserves, estimated at around 300 billion barrels, mostly heavy crude in the Orinoco Belt.
ev: Venezuela secedes from Gran Colombia and adopts its own constitution
Slavery is abolished under President José Gregorio Monagas
The Treaty of Coche ends the Federal War
The Barroso II blowout reveals the oil riches of Lake Maracaibo
Dictator Marcos Pérez Jiménez is overthrown; the Punto Fijo pact follows
The oil industry is nationalised and PDVSA is created
A new constitution creates the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela
